measurement: Has the learner identified a realistic target role?
Has the learner developed the essential skills required for the target role?
Has the learner identified and demonstrated relevant transferable skills?
Has the learner completed practical activities related to the target role?
Does the learner have tangible evidence demonstrating their capabilities?
Does the learner have a target-role-focused resume?
Can the learner handle common and role-specific interview tasks?
Has the learner started building relevant professional connections?
Is the learner prepared to identify and pursue relevant opportunities?
